articles.summary: Research shows children who play video games develop stronger working memory and impulse control. Here's what the science says and how to turn gaming into a foundation for real learning.
articles.title: How Computer Games Improve Your Child's Skills

articles.summary: Solene is 10 years old and has been learning to code at Strive since 2024. When she built her mum a website for her birthday, she gave us one of the clearest examples we've seen of how coding builds confidence in children.
articles.title: She Coded Her Mum a Birthday Gift: How Coding Builds Confidence in Children

articles.summary: Most parents sign their child up for coding hoping they'll pick up a useful skill. What often comes back is something they didn't expect. Tennyson's story shows how coding builds confidence in kids through the process of building something real.
articles.title: How Coding Builds Confidence in Kids

articles.summary: Finding the right coding classes for kids with ADHD is harder than it sounds. Before Amaya's first class, her parents sent a message explaining what she finds difficult. Their teacher's response shows what good inclusion actually looks like.
articles.title: What a Good Learning Environment Looks Like for a Child With ADHD
